audit.why: Early is a Syndra bully lane (Vlad Q at 9s early, no sustain items), mid is her conversion window, late tilts toward drain-tank Vlad — page states all three correctly.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[] has 3 entries, expected 4 — no full-build Vladimir spike.
audit.why: His 3+ item drain-tank/Hemoplague teamfighting is the whole reason the lane lead must convert; the array ends at level 6.

audit.whatIsWrong: tradeBad references 'the dash' — Vladimir has no dash; his dodge is Sanguine Pool (untargetable 2s). breakdown.cooldowns has no numbers. Anti-heal interaction present only as one clause in report[8].
audit.why: Kit: W 28s rank 1 down to 16s, untargetable 2 seconds; Q 9 to 4.6s heal-drain; R Hemoplague 120s heals per champion hit — Grievous Wounds is a real lever here.
audit.corrected: tradeBad rewritten around Sanguine Pool; cooldowns field now carries 28s/16s, 2s, and Q 9-4.6s numbers.

edits.before: Q the last-hit, W-slow the dodge attempt, QE the slowed line, Q again — a full bar of damage that started as routine poke.
edits.after: Two spheres near the wave make QE a point-and-click stun and feed R's sphere count — the bank is threat and execute ammo at once.

edits.before: Spending E on chip-spacing and then watching the dash you bought it for arrive unanswered — the stun is the matchup, not the damage.
edits.after: With R down your execute is gone and Vlad heals back every chip — past river you are the pick, and one gank resets the lead you built.

edits.before: Spending E on chip-spacing and then watching the dash you bought it for arrive unanswered — the stun is the matchup, not the damage.
edits.after: Combo-dumping into Sanguine Pool — two seconds untargetable eats your burst, and the R you spent stays down for the next 100-plus seconds.

edits.before: - Vladimir Sanguine Pool: matchup-defining — Untargetable dodge — bait it before you spend your kill window. Count it out loud if you must. - Your E Scatter the Weak has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Sanguine Pool: 28s at rank 1, 16s max, 2s untargetable — bait it, count it down, then the kill window is real. - Transfusion drains every 9s early (4.6s max); punish each cast with Q. - Your 15s E answers the all-in; R goes only where Pool is down.

edits.before: Late Syndra is a one-button court-martial: flank, QE the carry, R the verdict. Spheres on the ground are sentences waiting.
edits.after: Late Vlad drain-tanks fights, but your pick game still rules: flank, QE the carry, R the verdict before Hemoplague ramps the 5v5.
Full-build Vladimir is a drain-tank whose Hemoplague amp swings whole teamfights — QE him before he pools and buy Grievous Wounds so your R still finishes the job.
